messages:
tian: Kicking off a small canary for v3-int4 (quant) vs v3-fp16 baseline — 1% traffic, 2h window starting now. Focus slices: long-docs (seqlen>1024), short Q/A, rerank.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: canary_id=canary-2024-04-09-01, nodes=4, target=1%. Logs: https://infra/ci/canary-2024-04-09-01
rachael: Thanks — can you include seqlen-weighted metrics in the dashboard? long-doc concordance is our biggest worry. :eyes:
sam: Added slice + seqlen weight config to the canary:

```
seeds: [long-doc, short-qna, rerank]
weights: { long-doc: 0.5, short-qna: 0.3, rerank: 0.2 }
min_sample: 250
window: 15m
```

tian: Thx. For auto-fallback thresholds I'm proposing: concordance_delta <= -1.5% OR user_fuzzy_neg_rate increase >= 2pp OR latency_p99 > 300ms for two consecutive 15m windows -> trigger hard rollback. Soft-fallback: on long-docs, route to nf4-int4 variant when seqlen>2048.
mike: Slight tweak: concordance_delta -1.0% should surface alerts but only count as rollback if it persists across 3 windows or sample size >=500. Otherwise just flag. Latency threshold OK at 300ms.
rachael: Quick A/B snapshot after 45m (small sample):
- v3-fp16 baseline: avg_latency=160ms, p99=210ms, concordance_long=0.00%
- v3-int4 canary: avg_latency=150ms, p99=235ms, concordance_long=-1.2%
So concordance is slightly below proposed -1.5 but close. p99 drifted up on long-docs.
sam: Note that long-doc sample size so far = 320 (below 500). We should hold before auto-rollback. Also KV cache hit-rate on long-docs is lower for int4 variant -> investigate warmup.
tian: Agreed. Action items: 1) Hold auto-rollback until long-doc sample >=500 OR concordance <= -1.5% sustained for 2 windows. 2) Enable soft-fallback routing for seqlen>2048 immediately. 3) Add a short KV warmup run to the canary nodes and re-measure.
rachael: I logged the snapshot & thresholds to BenchDB: https://benchdb/entry/1704509876-spotcheck (includes CSV export). Also added a monitoring alert: canary_concordance_alert if delta <= -1.0% for 2 windows.
mike: I'll run KV warmup script on the canary pool: `./scripts/warm_kv.sh --nodes canary-2024-04-09-01` then report back.
deploy-bot: Canary canary-2024-04-09-01: KV warmup job queued (job=warmup-9876).
sam: After warmup (10m) rebench: long-doc concordance moved to -0.8%, p99 down to 225ms, sample now 510. That means concordance delta < -1.0 but > -1.5, sample >=500. Per agreed logic we do NOT auto-rollback, but escalate to oncall for manual review.
tian: Manual review ok. I'll open a quick SR to pause promotion and tag Product for fidelity decision. If concordance drops further to <= -1.5% in next 30m -> auto-rollback.
rachael: Filed SR: SR-4521 (pause promo) and pinged @product. Also exporting detailed diffs to /reports/canary-1704509876-diff.json.
mike: warmup notes: cache priming reduced cold-starts; we should add warmup step to standard canary for long-doc focused experiments.
tian: Good call — follow-up PR to canary pipeline to add optional kv-warmup for slices where seqlen-weight>0.4. I'll draft it.
rachael: Will keep dashboard live and update if concordance crosses -1.5% or latency_p99 > 300ms. Current status: HOLD (manual review) — long-doc concordance -0.9%, sample=530.
sam: tagging thread with :mag_right: and will collect more sliding-window stats every 15m.
tian: Thanks everyone. If product requests rollback we'll follow the hard rollback path. Otherwise we'll wait the remaining 75m and then make a promote/rollback decision based on the rules above.
